candidate.answerReason: The base AB has length 4 on the x-axis, and C is 3 units above it. Thus the area is \(4\times3\div2=6\) square units.

methods.label: Base and height from coordinates
methods.explanation: Take AB as the base. It lies on the x-axis and has length \(AB=4\). The distance from C to the x-axis is 3, so the height is 3. The area is \(\frac{1}{2}\times4\times3=6\).
methods.levelReason: Grade 7 coordinate facts identify the base and height; the triangle-area formula is elementary-school knowledge.
